question: Three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and third letter → Difference of the position values order according to English alphabetic series is (2).
 
• Second and fourth letter → Difference of the position values order according to English alphabetic series is (1).

​So,

 
• WPUQ

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07bc8928015c8c7a8ede93ffe8eaebdbe52803876c1a6a8991001afd79de8c6b.png] 

 
• MEKF

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/058a298851898bdd4e55df51f636e1c68391d72906d8e08876905d9c162658a4.png] 

 
• BXCY

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f072c88c4569b9b747fc2e69787b0dca18d6fbd8c858aaa42f3540be2de3ee5e.png] 

 
• ZLXM

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6828615fe2151dacd2de578fbd35794caf970195b68681af6efe325852a64f6.png] 

Thus, out of all options only '**BXCY**' doesn't follows the same logic as others.

Hence, the correct answer is "**BXCY**".
